name: Tebar: daily Telegram digest of unreplied comments

parameters.content:
## Unreplied comments digest
Every morning at 9:00 (workflow timezone), Telegram gets the 20 newest comments you have not replied to. No message when there are none.

**Setup**
1. **Unreplied comments**: pick your Tebar credential.
2. **Send to Telegram**: pick your Telegram bot credential and put your chat ID.
3. Activate the workflow.
